game.name: Dead Space 2 (Germany)(En,De)(Disc 2)
game.desc: Dead Space 2 is a science fiction survival horror video game set three years after the events of the first game. The game follows protagonist Isaac Clarke's fight against a new Necromorph outbreak on the Sprawl, a space station surrounding a shard of Saturn's largest moon, Titan. Unlike its predecessor, Dead Space 2 has a multiplayer mode, pitting human characters against Necromorphs across the Sprawl.
